rawContent: @G_Pijanowski If only we could stop climate change the same way we stopped nuclear buildup, by making an international treaty with foreign leaders. Maybe in some city like PARIS....🤫 #ClimateCrisis #ClimateActionNow
@thedailybeast In this age of #ClimateCrisis, we should be happy that SOMEONE is taking the bus.

@BobItsbobmd @VoidIsOP @AOC I will call out UBER over climate change. Why aren't they switching over their entire fleet to electric? Because they don't own their own fleet.  Their basic business model fails to take into account the #ClimateCrisis.

@BoxerOrwell @dethrockboy @reason Uber's basic business model requires a blurring of the boundary between business and personal relationships. That is never going to go well.

My main concern is #climate. If they owned a fleet, they could switch to electric easily, without making drivers pay.
